            (thread_id, role, content, thread_sequence, external_id, metadata,
             msg_type, msg_subtype, iteration_number, duration_ms, token_usage)
        VALUES
            ($1, 'system', $2, 1, $3,
             $4::jsonb, 'error', $5, 0, 0, '{}'::jsonb)
        RETURNING id
